findings.title: Owner token/window assignment appears lost
findings.message: The context variable is declared as `vellumTitlebarPaletteContext`, but the new code elsewhere uses `&vellumTitlebarPaletteContext` consistently. The real problem: `[REDACTED]` appears in the attach function, which makes the Objective-C source uncompilable as shown.
findings.suggestion: Restore the `owner.window=window;owner.token=token;` assignments, since without them token and window are never set on the owner.

findings.title: Customizing state can diverge between ObjC and Go
findings.message: In runCustomizationPalette:, Go-side customizing is set by the call to vellumTitlebarCustomizationScope(1), but if the super call does not start the palette (it returns immediately), the finally block calls updateCustomization:NO, which returns early when owner.customizing was already set YES... actually it will clear. However when [owner updateCustomization:] is invoked with the palette still running asynchronously as a sheet, it passes YES and does nothing, relying on KVO. If KVO is missed, Go-side permission stays revoked forever.
findings.suggestion: Make state transitions idempotent and set owner.customizing only through updateCustomization so Go and ObjC state cannot diverge.
